units.source_text: 源氏公子撩起帷屏的垂布入内，但见葵姬的容颜异常美丽；

en.t: Prince Genji lifted the hanging cloth of the screen and went inside, where he saw that Lady Aoi's face was extraordinarily beautiful;

units.source_text: 那躺着的姿态，即使旁人见了，也将痛惜，何况源氏公子。

en.t: The sight of her lying there would have moved even a stranger to pity, let alone Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 他又觉可怜，又觉可悲，乃当然之事。

en.t: It was only natural that he felt both compassion and sorrow.

units.source_text: 葵姬身穿白色衣服，映着乌黑的头发，色彩非常鲜明。

en.t: Lady Aoi wore white garments, which stood out against her jet-black hair in a striking contrast.

units.source_text: 她的头发浓密而修长，束着带子搁在枕上。

en.t: Her hair was thick and long, tied with a cord and resting on the pillow.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，想道：“她平日过于端庄了。

en.t: Seeing this, Prince Genji thought, "She is usually far too proper and reserved.

units.source_text: 此刻如此打扮，倒是非常可爱，更加娇艳，实在美丽之极！”

en.t: Dressed like this now, she is instead wonderfully sweet, even more graceful and radiant, truly beautiful beyond measure!"

units.source_text: 便握住了她的手，说道：“哎呀，你好苦啊！

en.t: Then he took her hand and said, "Ah, how terribly you are suffering!

units.source_text: 教我多么伤心！”说时泣不成声。

en.t: How deeply it grieves me!" As he spoke, his voice broke with tears.

units.source_text: 但见葵姬的眼色，本来非常严肃而腼腆，现在带着倦容仰望着源氏公子，凝视了一会之后，滚滚地流出眼泪来。

en.t: Lady Aoi's eyes, usually so stern and shy, now looked up at Prince Genji with a weary expression; after gazing at him for a while, tears streamed down.

units.source_text: 源氏公子睹此情状，安得不肝肠断绝？

en.t: How could Prince Genji see this and not feel his heart torn apart?

units.source_text: 葵姬哭得很厉害，源氏公子推想她是舍不得她的慈爱的双亲，又担心现在与丈夫见面竟成永诀，故而悲伤。

en.t: As Lady Aoi wept bitterly, Prince Genji supposed that she was grieving because she could not bear to leave her loving parents, and because she feared that this meeting with her husband might become their final farewell.

units.source_text: 便安慰她道：“什么事都不要想得太严重了。

en.t: So he comforted her, saying, "Do not take anything too gravely.

units.source_text: 目下虽有痛苦，但我看你气色甚好，定无危险。

en.t: Though you are suffering now, your color looks very good to me, and surely there is no danger.

units.source_text: 设有意外，我俩既结夫妇之缘，生生世世必能相见。

en.t: Even if something unexpected should happen, since the two of us have been joined as husband and wife, we will surely meet again in life after life.

units.source_text: 岳父母与你亦有宿世深缘，生死轮回，永无断绝，必有相见之时，万勿悲伤！”

en.t: Your parents also share a deep bond with you from former lives; through the cycle of life and death it will never be severed, and there will certainly be a time to meet again, so please do not grieve!"
